name: cluster: falling objects, heavier-falls-faster cluster first

input.question: Drop a bowling ball and a tennis ball from the same height at the same moment. Which one lands first, and why?
input.referenceAnswer: Ignoring air resistance they land together: gravity accelerates every object at the same rate regardless of its mass.

clusters.label: Heavier objects fall faster
samples: The bowling ball, it is heavier so gravity pulls it harder
Bowling ball first because it weighs more
Heavier things fall faster, that is just how it works

clusters.label: Both land at the same time
samples: Same time, Galileo showed it
They hit together, gravity is the same for everything
Both at once if there is no air

clusters.label: Air resistance slows the lighter ball
samples: The tennis ball is slowed more by the air so the bowling ball wins by a tiny bit
Air pushes back on the tennis ball more
Drag matters more for the light one

samples: depends on the height
